title: Use-case seed domain entity
purpose: Promote seed domains such as trades, oil_gas, animal_hospital, geographic_analysis, and trust_safety into reusable graph nodes without changing top-level taxonomy fields.
privacy_rule: Synthetic or public domain names only; no private tenant categories.

title: Hierarchical label path entity
purpose: Represent flexible hierarchy paths and ancestors as graph nodes for rollups, dedupe blocks, and browsing.
privacy_rule: Generated label paths remain candidates until reviewed.

title: Input and output type entity
purpose: Link primitives that accept similar source material or emit compatible object families.
privacy_rule: Input and output type names should be generic, not user-provided confidential data.

title: Required pipeline stage edge
purpose: Connect candidate primitives to required stages such as source governance, entity linking, fuzzy dedupe, review routing, and index emission.
privacy_rule: Stage edges are deterministic seed metadata and do not include private source text.

title: Graph index entity edge
purpose: Store entity-linked graph edges in index records so retrieval can mix keyword, vector, facet, and graph evidence.
privacy_rule: Graph metadata must use canonical entity IDs, not raw private mentions.
